description: A sandboxed ACP agent asked about this branch's pull request should reach GitHub through Copse's bridged gh_*/CI tools rather than from its own process, whose sandbox.allowedDomains carries no GitHub host. Two conditions make the pass meaningful together: no GitHub host in a sandbox_network_audit card (the agent's own process never got denied GitHub) and at least one bridged GitHub or CI call (it actually did the work through Copse). Without the second, a run that never attempted GitHub at all would pass, since the denial is absent either way. The forbid is scoped to GitHub hosts rather than to the audit card as a whole because an adapter's own telemetry is denied on most turns — Claude's Datadog intake, Cursor's npm registry — which says nothing about how it reached GitHub. Runs against the current workspace because the bridged tools resolve the pull request from this repo's GitHub remote; in a temp project they would fail for lack of a remote and push the agent to its own shell for a reason unrelated to the steer.
prompts: Is CI passing on the open pull request for this branch? Summarise any failing checks. Don't modify any files.
